**Overview**
 As a Network Services team member, you will gain exposure to a large and complex network topology. We are responsible for monitoring, maintaining, and providing support for the firm’s global enterprise network. Our mission is to continually evolve our network infrastructure and invest heavily in advancing our technology. Joining Network Services is the first step in building an engineering career with SIG.
   

  

 What sets us apart?
   

  

**We want your input**
 In addition to troubleshooting issues across our environment, your job is to find innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will contribute in network design discussion and participate in solution implementations. And you will help shape the future of our network monitoring and configuration management products.
   

  

**Exposure to a variety of tech**
 At SIG we use a diverse set of technologies to ensure we are operating in the most optimal way. You will gain exposure to a multitude of different technologies including, WAN, LAN, Enterprise and Carrier Networking During team rotations you will partner with senior engineers and technical leads to work a wide array of projects. Projects will start with basic operational tasks, as your skills grow you will be working in tandem to develop innovative solutions that you will deploy company wide.
   

  

**We collaborate**
 Our team actively collaborates with itself, other technologists, and business teams. The best network is created by understanding its demands. It is crucial in our environment to work together so we can coordinate configuration changes, identify root\-cause analysis, recommend network optimizations, and participate in firm wide projects including upgrading and implementing new hardware and software.
   

  

**Hands on Learning**
 At SIG, you learn the most by doing. With guidance and mentoring from your team, you’ll get hands\-on experience beginning on your first day. Spend some time in the lab and test out new configurations before implementing firm wide! You will gain knowledge and hands on experience across our infrastructure through rotations with our Networking Engineers as well as opportunities to participate with our other services teams that focus in Security, Windows, Linux, Virtual, Storage, and DevOps teams.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* BS or MS in Computer Science, Networking, Engineering or a similar technical major.
* Experience in LAN network support, specifically troubleshooting OSI Layer 1\-3 problems – network switching experience is a plus.
* Demonstrated knowledge of network hardware, local area networks, internet protocols, fiber and copper wiring standards, Ethernet, and wireless technologies.
* Scripting and DevOps experience (in Python, Ansible, Git) is highly preferred.

**Embedded Software Engineer \- Wireless** 




 Our client is hiring an Embedded Software Engineer specializing in wireless, to help advance a new class of connected products built for demanding, real world environments. This is a high impact opportunity to shape firmware at the core of intelligent wireless devices, work closely with experienced technical leaders, and contribute to products where reliability, speed, and practical engineering matter every day. For engineers who enjoy solving tough system level problems and seeing their work move quickly from concept to deployment, this role offers meaningful ownership and visibility.
 



  





**This Role Offers:** 



* Work on advanced embedded products that rely on resilient wireless communication and real time performance.
* Join a growth stage team where engineers have direct influence on architecture, product quality, and release execution.
* Tackle technically challenging work across firmware, hardware interaction, networking behavior, and system validation.
* Collaborate with experienced engineering leadership in an environment that values initiative, curiosity, and sound decision making.
* Opportunity to help improve how connected devices perform in distributed, high demand use cases.



  





**Focus:** 



* Design, build, test, and maintain embedded software for wireless products operating in real time environments.
* Develop production quality Embedded C code for RTOS based systems running on microcontrollers, embedded processors, and wireless SoCs.
* Support software behavior across drivers, peripherals, protocol handling, timing sensitive workflows, and application level functionality.
* Contribute to wireless networking features involving node discovery, communication reliability, coordination across multiple devices, and overall system responsiveness.
* Investigate and resolve issues found in lab testing, validation cycles, integration efforts, and field scenarios.
* Improve software quality through logging, diagnostics, automation, scripting, and repeatable test methods.
* Work closely with hardware, systems, test, and product teams to deliver dependable releases.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical planning activities.



  





**Skill Set:** 



* Strong C programming experience in embedded environments.
* Hands on background with RTOS based development, including Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or related platforms.
* Experience with embedded interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, ADC, and common debugging workflows.
* Solid understanding of real time systems, concurrency, interrupts, timers, and memory constrained design.
* Experience working with embedded processors, microcontrollers, or wireless SoCs.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across embedded firmware and hardware interaction.
* Background in wireless communications, networking protocols, mesh systems, telecom devices, or RF connected products is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to testing, automation, validation processes, and Python scripting is preferred.
* Ability to communicate clearly and operate effectively in a collaborative, fast moving engineering environment.
